svg.text: PS = S1 + I1 + S2 = 36; TEXT EDGE ADDS B.
PE = WA + S2 + S3 = WA + 13; TEXT EDGE ADDS B.
ACTION WIDTH IS MEASURED; WA = 24 IS THE INITIAL FALLBACK.
BASE UI NATIVE INPUT; WIDTH FILLS ITS WRAPPER.
NO FIXED MINIMUM WIDTH OR EXTRA HIT AREA.
OPTIONAL ICON IS DECORATIVE; ACTION IS INTERACTIVE.
ACTION WIDTH TRACKS RESIZE WITHOUT REMOUNTING.
NUMBER / FILE TYPES IGNORE CUSTOM END ACTION.
NATIVE DATE / TIME CHROME IS BROWSER-OWNED.
DEFAULT, PLAIN AND UNDERLINE SHARE H1.
FOCUS TONE CHANGES COLOR, NOT GEOMETRY.
DISABLED OPACITY IS 50%; GEOMETRY IS UNCHANGED.
INPUTCOUNT IS A SEPARATE CALLER-PLACED SLOT.
NEUTRAL BOXED FOCUS: Y = 0, BL = 0, SP = 3.
ACCENT / INVALID BOXED RING ALSO USES E = 3.
RESTING FIELD HAS NO ELEVATION SHADOW.
PROPORTIONAL SCHEMATIC · Z SEPARATION NOT TO SCALE
11 JSX USES ACROSS 7 INSPECTOR FILES; ALL THREE VARIANTS REVIEWED.
PLAIN: B = 0; UNDERLINE: BOTTOM B = 1, R = 0.
UNDERLINE ICON INSET = 0; PS = I1 + S2 = 24.
INVALID / DISABLED / READONLY KEEP THE SAME FIELD SIZE.
